scope.summary: Bind a StudioTextStory to a StudioVectorPath (geometry owned by 14.5, never reimplemented here) with path-text options: alignment to path, spacing at curves, flip, and effect/rainbow modes. This is the SINGLE Studio text-on-path capability shared with the vector and typography domains; do not fork a second path-text implementation. Composition through TextEngine over vector geometry.
acceptance_criteria: single text-on-path capability binding StudioTextStory to StudioVectorPath with all path-text options
proof_targets: path-text compose runtime over shared vector geometry
expected_tests: live: StudioTextStory binds to a StudioVectorPath and composes along it with alignment/spacing/flip/effect options
test: uses shared 14.5 vector geometry (no forked path math)

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Text on a path

risk_if_missed: No text-on-path; or a forked duplicate path-text engine (dedup violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
